paragraphs: Yehudah bar Shmuel saw Ketev Meriri and did not fall; nevertheless he died: Rabbah, Naso, section 12; Eikhah, on “Judah went into exile.” [That parallel says the pious man fell and died, gives Yehudah Berabbi as one identification, and separately says that Shmuel saw and did not fall.]
